name: CoAuthLock
description: Represents a lock within the document. The CoAuthLock object is a member of the CoAuthLocks collection.
remarks: Use Locks (index), where index is the index number, to return a CoAuthLock object. When adding a CoAuthLock object, use the WdLockType enumeration to specify the type of lock.
example:
Dim myLock as CoAuthLock

Set myLock = ActiveDocument.CoAuthoring.Locks(1)

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified CoAuthLock object.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns a WdLockType constant that specifies the lock type. Read-only.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that is contained in the specified object. Read-only.
